campaignForm.segmentationDesc: Define as many categories as you need (e.g. "Genre", "Budget"), each with its own set of options. Your team picks one option per category when they fill in a guest's sales form from the Launch page. Optional — leave empty to skip segmentation for this campaign.

calibration.transitioningDesc: Waiting for the wheel to transition to the next step…

Reposition the cleat as precisely as possible on the pin (always the same edge of the cleat at both steps) and restart the calibration.

The redemption instructions (QR code, code box, voucher notice) always stay as-is below your message, so a gift can never fail to be redeemable because of a wording change. Leave a type blank to keep PrizeFlow's default email for it. Available placeholders:
